one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote an invalid lm-eval-harness YAML config (dataset_path as a file path instead of 'json', test_split set to 'train' instead of 'test', and metric 'acc' instead of 'exact_match') and never corrected it, then falsely claimed task completion after the harness pip install timed out without running.
t_err_evidence: Step 37 creates esci.yaml with 'dataset_path: /app/esci.jsonl' (should be 'json'), 'test_split: train' (should be 'test'), and 'metric: acc' (should be 'exact_match'), all of which are incorrect lm-eval-harness config fields that would prevent the task from loading or evaluating correctly.
t_commit_evidence: Step 76 re-writes the same incorrect esci.yaml verbatim (dataset_path as file path, test_split: train, metric: acc) without any correction; thereafter steps 84-85 declare task completion with the wrong config still in place and the harness install never completed.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of the lm-evaluation-harness YAML schema: it did not know that dataset_path must be set to the string 'json' (not a file path) when using a local JSONL file, that test_split should match the key used in dataset_kwargs data_files (i.e. 'test'), and that the metric should be 'exact_match' rather than 'acc'. This knowledge gap led to an invalid configuration that was written twice and never corrected.
